subject.title: refactor(update): split update-command into focused modules under the line limit

question: Should this maintainer-labeled update refactor be accepted after fresh-install and upgrade-path runtime proof, or should it stay paused until that operational proof is available?
rationale: The diff changes only internal layout, but the moved workflow controls installation mutation, child-process resumption, doctor execution, and gateway service recovery; automated unit coverage cannot fully establish those operational contracts.

options.title: Require update-path proof
options.body: Rebase on current main and attach redacted evidence from package and git update scenarios showing the final CLI version, doctor result, and managed-service outcome.

options.title: Accept test-only refactor evidence
options.body: Merge based on the existing focused checks while explicitly accepting residual risk in the updater handoff paths.
